subtitle: Daily Queens Logic Puzzle
promotionalText: Place one cat in every color — a cozy logic puzzle with a new board every day and 500 levels from 5×5 to 9×9.
description:
Place one cat in every color — that's it!

Kitty Queens is a cozy logic puzzle with three simple rules:
• Each color gets exactly 1 cat
• Each row and each column gets 1 cat
• Cats can't touch — not even corners

Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and you can always reach it by logic — no guessing.

■ A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Today's Puzzle is the same for everyone. Solve it daily to keep your streak going.

■ 500 LEVELS
Start with quick 5×5 boards and work up to brain-bending 9×9. Replay any level you've solved and see how many are left.

■ EASY ON THE EYES AND FINGERS
Big squares, clear colors with bold borders, and the rules always on screen. Pick Cat or Mark, then tap. Drag to mark many squares at once.

■ FRIENDLY HELP
Break a rule and the app shows you why. Stuck? It tells you which row or color has no spot left. Watch a short video for a hint or 3 more hearts.

■ PLAY ANYWHERE
Works offline — perfect for the bus, the subway or a coffee break. No account, no sign-in.

Levels 1–30 are free. Unlock more levels by watching a short video, or get all 500 levels and remove banner ads with a one-time purchase.
reviewNotes:
Logic puzzle game (Queens / Star Battle style). No account or login.

How to play: place one cat in every color region, one per row and column; cats cannot touch, even diagonally. Pick 'Cat' or 'Mark' at the bottom, then tap a square.

Modes: Today's Puzzle (one new board per day, same for everyone) and Levels (500 levels, 5x5 to 9x9). Levels 1-30 are free. Each further pack of 20 levels unlocks by watching one rewarded video, or the non-consumable in-app purchase 'Unlock All Levels' (com.soulfulfill.catdoku.unlockall, $1.99) unlocks all 500 levels and removes banner ads. To reach it quickly: Home > 'All levels' — the unlock box sits above the first locked pack. 'Restore purchase' is at the bottom of that screen.

Ads: Google AdMob banner + optional rewarded videos (hint, +3 hearts after losing, unlock 20 levels). If no video is available, the reward is granted anyway. The app does not request tracking permission.

No backend server; puzzles are generated on the device. English only.
